title: Breaking the Cloak! Unveiling Chinese Cloaked Toxicity with Homophone Graph and Toxic Lexicon
abstract: arXiv:2505.22184v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Social media platforms have experienced a significant rise in toxic content, including abusive language and discriminatory remarks, presenting growing challenges for content moderation. Some users evade censorship by deliberately disguising toxic words through homophonic cloak, which necessitates the task of unveiling cloaked toxicity. Existing methods are mostly designed for English texts, while Chinese cloaked toxicity unveiling has not been solved yet. Then it filters those candidates that are non-toxic and corrects cloaks to be their corresponding toxicities. translated_title: 打破伪装！基于同音字图谱与毒性词典的中文谐音毒性内容识别
translated_abstract: 社交媒体平台上的毒性内容（包括辱骂性语言和歧视性言论）显著增加，给内容审核带来了越来越大的挑战。一些用户通过故意用谐音伪装毒性词汇来规避审查，这使得识别伪装毒性内容成为一项必要的任务。现有方法大多针对英文文本设计，而中文伪装毒性内容的识别问题尚未得到解决。为解决这一问题，我们提出了C$^2$TU，这是一种新颖的无需训练、无需提示（prompt-free）的中文伪装毒性内容识别方法。该方法首先利用子串匹配，基于中文同音字图谱和毒性词典识别候选毒性词汇。然后，它过滤掉那些无毒的候选词，并将伪装词纠正为其对应的毒性词。具体而言，我们开发了两种用于过滤的模型变体，分别基于BERT和大语言模型（LLMs）。
tldr: 提出了C$^2$TU，一种无需训练、无需提示的新方法，利用中文同音字图谱和毒性词典，通过子串匹配识别候选毒性词并进行过滤纠正，有效破解社交媒体中以谐音伪装毒性词汇规避审查的内容。
en_tdlr: Proposes C$^2$TU, a novel training-free and prompt-free method that unveils Chinese cloaked toxicity by using a Chinese homophone graph and toxic lexicon to identify candidate toxic words via substring matching, then filtering and correcting homophone-disguised toxic content on social media.
